senses.gloss: निःक˚ niḥ-ka-, v. निष्क˚ niṣka-.

निःक्षत्रिय niḥ-kṣatriya, a. having no warrior 🞄caste;
 -kṣepa, m. sending away, removal.
निःप˚ niḥ-pa-, -pha-, v. निष्प˚ niṣpa-, -pha-.
निःशाखीकृ niḥ-śākhī-kṛ, deprive of 🞄branches.
निःशुक्र niḥ-śukra, a. deprived of majesty.
निःशेषय niḥ-śeṣa-ya, den. P. destroy completely: 🞄pp. ita, utterly consumed or destroyed.
निःशोक niḥ-śoka, a. free from sorrow.
निःष्पन्दता niḥ-ṣpanda-tā, f. motionlessness.

निःस्तम्भ niḥ-stambha, a. lacking pillars;
 🞄having no support.

निःस्वीकृ niḥ-svī-kṛ, deprive of oneʼs property;
 🞄-svī-bhū, lose oneʼs property.
